title: Mister Skinnylegs
hook: 乔治在水槽里发现一只蜘蛛，把它当成娃娃放到床上，还请它喝下午茶。

cells.a: She is playing with her doll's house, and George joins in.
cells.cn: 她在玩娃娃屋，乔治也一起玩。

cells.q: What did Peppa ask George to do?
cells.a: She asked him to fill the teapot with water.
He found a spider in the kitchen sink.
cells.cn: 他在厨房水槽里发现一只蜘蛛。

cells.q: What is George doing with the spider?
cells.a: He is putting the spider to bed in the doll's house.
cells.cn: 他正把蜘蛛放到娃娃屋里睡觉。

cells.a: She asked him if he has seen the spider.
cells.cn: 她问他有没有看见那只蜘蛛。

cells.a: He said he will take the spider out of the bedroom.
cells.cn: 他说会把蜘蛛拿出卧室。

cells.q: Do the children mind the spider?
cells.a: No, Peppa and George like the spider very much.
cells.cn: 不，佩奇和乔治都很喜欢这只蜘蛛。

cells.a: His name is Mr. Skinnylegs, and they have tea with him.
cells.cn: 他叫“瘦腿先生”，他们还和它一起喝茶。

cells.q: Who is scared of the spider?
cells.a: Daddy Pig is scared, but he says he is not.
cells.cn: 猪爸爸其实很怕，可他说自己不怕。
